verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a web-scraping API service, not an agent or host that consumes external tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. Its official MCP server (mcp.scrapingbee.com) is server-side, letting agents use ScrapingBee, and does not count toward plugging MCP servers into the product. Nothing in the evidence shows ScrapingBee itself consuming MCP servers.
